verdict.rationale: Bolt gives its AI control of the full environment, including the filesystem and a Node server, and lets users start from a blank prompt. It also adds backend pieces (database, auth, edge functions) through Bolt Database or Supabase. No evidence shows one prompt producing a coupled frontend plus backend: hands-on reports show a frontend built quickly, then errors once a database was added, and a criticism that the backend is outsourced to Supabase. missing for 10: explicit documentation of single-prompt full-stack generation, hands-on corroboration that the frontend and backend are generated together and work, and evidence of custom backend logic beyond Supabase-backed database/auth/functions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate both frontend UI and backend logic from a single prompt

citations.quote: Bolt.new gives AI models complete control over the entire environment including the filesystem, node server, package manager, terminal, and browser console.
Anyone can start from a blank prompt
Use Supabase with Bolt to add a database, authentication, or edge functions to your app as an alternative to Bolt Database.
Bolt makes it easy to add database functionality to your app without the hassle of extra infrastructure.
